Things to explore

Three ways to experience myhealth.

As a patient

Browse records, find a doctor, explore appointments, and open the Care Navigator.

As a staff member

Open a schedule, review a patient chart, and discover the workspace for each clinical role.

As an administrator

Explore clinic accounts, appointments, departments, and administrative tools.

Do I need to create an account?

No. Choose one of the demo-account shortcuts on the app’s sign-in screen.

Does the demo use real patient information?

No. The hosted demonstration uses synthetic data and browser-local storage.

Are live AI and payments connected?

Live report AI needs a configured service. The payment demonstration is simulated and does not move real money.
